title: ComfyUI-UML: diagrams inside a node graph

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if a diagram were just another step in your image workflow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's ComfyUI-UML. ComfyUI is a node-based tool where you wire steps together, and Antoine added nodes that make diagrams.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So how does a diagram get in there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Text goes into the workflow. A rendering backend turns it into an image. And the workflow can keep the source text and viewer links next to the result.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Handy, so the diagram stays tied to what produced it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It brings automated UML generation into the same pipelines people already use for images. It's written mostly in Python, with some JavaScript for the interface side, and has tests.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A small piece, but it plugs two worlds together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The written page has the details.
